correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the channel to unit insertion plus at most one adjacent unit transfer in the zero-gap vector, counts constructions with an explicit and exhaustive collision analysis, and optimizes the resulting exact formula. An independent direct string-level enumerator agrees pointwise for every received word through \(n=10\) and the support optimization is checked through \(n=200\). The computation corroborates rather than substitutes for the universal proof.
